title: Source/release freshness, DXF encoding, and 3D evidence ceiling
mode: Primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation; plan-only
scope: Refresh authoritative DXF string and binary-chunk rules for versioned compatibility review.
Reconcile peer release, mutable master, issue, and milestone states without treating them as interchangeable support evidence.
Reconfirm availability and licensing boundary for an independent ACIS semantic witness.
Refine implementation readiness while preserving the focused local validation cadence and non-blocking external gates.

sources.revision: Official AutoCAD 2026 DXF group-code reference accessed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The reference identifies codes 310-319 as hexadecimal binary chunks and states that R2007+ DXF strings use UTF-8 while R2004 and earlier use plain ASCII/CIF with Unicode control sequences.
sources.limits: A normative wire rule does not prove that a peer or local callback/adapter retains, orders, or reconstructs every field or chunk.

sources.revision: Mutable NEWS/issues/milestones accessed 2026-10-20; issue #1357 identifies old release e405fcff and reporter-verified master commit 56a05f98; no executable or fixture was run
sources.observed: The 0.14 milestone is closed and states DWG write coverage for 2004-2018 except 2007. The 0.14.1 milestone remains open and showed 13 open items / 67% completion when inspected. Issue #1357 is still listed/open in that milestone, while its reporter says an AC1021 regression was verified fixed on master commit 56a05f98; modelspace aggregate counts matched ODA and ezdxf on three inputs after R2007 decoder fixes.
sources.limits: Milestone and issue states do not define released-binary behavior. The reported comparison is not independently reproduced here and aggregate count does not establish per-object identity, ownership, or semantic equivalence.

sources.revision: Mutable repository pages accessed 2026-10-20; v3.8.0 release identified; PR #1240 unmerged in reviewed state; v1.0 roadmap discussion predates v3.8.0
sources.observed: The version matrix advertises versioned DXF/DWG reader/writer routes without an entity-family denominator. Issue #1195 reports DXF writer omission of Solid3D/Region against an older package; visible PR #1240 is DWG ModelerGeometry writing and does not establish a released DXF fix. The historical v1.0 roadmap named Solid3D and proxies as then-missing, but predates v3.8.0.
sources.limits: No ACadSharp artifact or code was built or run. The old roadmap is not evidence of current v3.8.0 behavior, and the unmerged DWG writer change cannot be credited as DXF support.

sources.project: Open CASCADE Technology and commercial components
sources.revision: Open Cascade SAS announcement dated 2026-03-10 and mutable component preview accessed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: The announcement separates open-source core exchange formats from commercial DXF and ACIS SAT/SAB data-exchange components. No general ACIS kernel in the open-source OCCT core was identified by this pass.
sources.limits: This is an availability/licensing statement, not proof that no independent open-source implementation exists anywhere; no component was obtained or run.

sources.observed: The plan already contains per-source dispositions, versioned DXF/codepage and carrier tests, route-specific peer admission, and PAR-07/S8 separation of carriers, ACIS/AcDs association, geometry semantics, and native consumers.
sources.limits: No new local code or test result follows from this research. Existing test owners were referenced rather than rerun or duplicated.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06/PAR-49: separate issue/milestone state, immutable master result, and released executable evidence; keep per-source identity and loss accounting above aggregate counts
PAR-07/S8: keep object shell, raw carrier, ACIS record graph, DWG AcDs association, B-rep validity, and consumer acceptance separate; external kernel availability remains optional
PAR-14: use current Autodesk versioned string and binary chunk rules only when a local source audit finds an uncovered encoding boundary

planChanges: Added a source-freshness crosswalk distinguishing released binaries, mutable master fixes, open issues/milestones, and unmerged proposals.
Refreshed Autodesk's R2007 string encoding and 310-319 binary-chunk rules as targeted versioned test criteria, with reuse of existing tests preferred over duplicates.
Made ACadSharp's version matrix and historical Solid3D/proxy roadmap explicitly insufficient to prove current per-family output support; kept DXF and DWG writer directions separate.
Reaffirmed that commercial OCCT ACIS components are not an open-source-core semantic witness and do not block local carrier/owner-graph work.
limitations: Mutable GitHub master, issue, release, and milestone pages were not pinned or downloaded as immutable archives; exact repository state can change.
Peer reports and maintainer release statements were not independently reproduced with binaries or drawings.
This pass found no new local defect and does not provide independent native-application or ACIS-kernel semantic evidence.
No existing code/test target was built or executed because this was a plan-only research update.
